d.d: The position of a person or team in a tournament or competition who draws no opponent in a particular round so advances to the next round unopposed, or is awarded points for a win in a league table; also the phantom opponent of such a person or team.
d.x: Craig's Crew plays the bye next week.

d.d: An extra scored when the batsmen take runs after the ball has passed the striker without hitting either the bat or the batsman.
